scope: Selected existing checkpoints; a new future-action distribution, not a replacement of frozen benchmark scores.

protocol.source_rule: Keep all ordered source scenes, history pixels/actions, current state, goals and hidden parameters unchanged. Regenerate only future actions and futures.

action_rule.selection: Largest factor for each original candidate with both objects complete geometry in bounds at every raw step under all hidden conditions
action_rule.deduplication: Exact float32 full action bytes; equal weight per unique candidate within scene
action_rule.failure: Retain source and failed receipt; do not silently exclude

diagnostic_pixel_alias_rule.purpose: Counterexample search only; absence does not prove identifiability

evaluation.score: Same native-latent full prediction formula on a new action distribution; do not overwrite or directly rank against old-panel scores
evaluation.physical_readout: Auxiliary source-group cross-fitted readout recalibrated on new true futures; calibration error must be reported separately

weighting: Equal conditions, unique candidates and horizons within each scene; ratio of scene-mean error sums; source-group bootstrap.
readout_scope: Auxiliary Development crossfit only; true-latent calibration and predicted-latent readout errors remain separate.
